text:
maria: Heads-up — eu-west pool spike around 13:05 UTC. Queue depth jumped and batch sizes blew up (typical batch target 8 -> observed 35-42). p50 latency ~3x for short period. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/infra/eu-west-pool?panel=queue-depth

jon: saw that too. Autoscaler didn't add capacity quickly; pool reported 'saturated' but pods stayed Pending for ~90s. Any network errors in the same window?

tara: yep, saw a cluster-egress 503 storm to eu-s3 (internal proxy) at 13:04-13:07. A bunch of agent-side uploads failed and retried which inflated request sizes and queueing. Snip from agent logs:

```
2026-05-12T13:04:57Z agent-7f4d INFO upload failed status=503 url=https://eu-s3.redwood.local/parts/abc retry=1
2026-05-12T13:05:02Z agent-3c2a WARN upload failed status=503 url=https://eu-s3.redwood.local/parts/def retry=2
2026-05-12T13:05:20Z scheduler ERROR queueing request id=xyz reason=network_backpressure
```

kevin: thanks, that matches the networking alerts. I also see the batch estimator bumped target_batch_size after retries caused many small inferences to pile up. The estimator uses `min(64, max(8, median_request_window*scale))` which overshot when request rate spiked.

maria: operationally we missed an opportunity to pre-scale. Current Prometheus alert is `queue_depth > 500 FOR 2m` which didn't fire because the spike was very bursty and often dropped below 500 between bursts. Propose: use a smoothed/quantile metric and include batch_growth rate. Example alert rule suggestion: 

```yaml
- alert: SustainedHighQueueOrBatchGrowth
  expr: (increase(queue_depth[3m]) > 300) or (histogram_quantile(0.9, sum(rate(batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 20)
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "Sustained queue growth or batch size growth in {{ $labels.pool }}"
```

jon: lgtm. Also add a recording rule for `effective_headroom = (gpu_capacity - running_tokens) / gpu_capacity` so dashboards can show headroom % directly. Example PromQL: 

```
record: infra:effective_headroom:ratio
expr: (gpu_pool_capacity - sum(gpu_running_tokens)) / gpu_pool_capacity
```

tara: on dashboards, add a small-panel time-series of `effective_headroom` and a heatmap of `batch_size by node` so we can correlate hot nodes. Also annotate network 5xx events on the time range.

kevin: for short term mitigation I'm going to bump the autoscaler headroom multiplier for `eu-west` from `1.1` -> `1.25` and enable a short 5-min aggressive burst window. If network errors persist we should schedule 2 reserved GPUs for peak hours.

autoscale-bot: autoscaler: updated headroom multiplier for pool=eu-west to 1.25 (by kevin). Next reconciliation in 60s.

maria: tl;dr action items:
- kevin: bump headroom (done) + schedule 2 reserved GPUs for peak (action: please make reservation by EOD)
- jon: add recording rule for `effective_headroom` and update the alert rule (PR to monitoring repo)
- tara: update eu-west Grafana dashboard: add panel + heatmap + annotation feed for network 5xx
- infra-sre: run replay of 13:04-13:08 with load testing to validate autoscaler behavior

kevin: will take reservation and run quick smoke today. jon I'll ping you after the PR.

maria: thanks. I'll watch the dashboards during the next peak window and loop back if anything else looks off. :thumbsup:
